name: @pipeworx/mcp-odds-api

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: List available sports/leagues. By default returns only in-season; pass all=true to include out-of-season.

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Current odds for upcoming + live events in a league. Each market type costs 1 quota credit per region per call — pick markets carefully.

regions.description: us | uk | eu | au — comma-sep (default us)

markets.description: h2h | spreads | totals | outrights — comma-sep (default h2h)

tools.name: get_event_odds
tools.description: Odds for a single event — allows richer markets (player props, alt lines). Higher quota cost per call.

markets.description: Includes player_props_* markets for some leagues

tools.name: get_scores
tools.description: Live + recent final scores. Costs 2 requests per call.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Upcoming + live events for a league (without odds — useful to discover event IDs).

tools.name: odds_api_quota
tools.description: Monthly request credits left and used on the key serving this call, read from The Odds API usage headers. Says whether the odds and scores tools can return data right now and how large the plan is.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-odds-api forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the odds-api pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
